falseSynonyms.zh: 本地區域不等於 local communities local area 是地理範圍；communities 是人和社會群體。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Area is a place; community is people.

falseSynonyms.zh: 社區／街區不等於所有 communities neighbourhood 可指地理街區，也可指社區，但語義更偏地點。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Neighbourhood is often place-focused.

falseSynonyms.zh: 居民不等於所有 local communities residents 只指住戶，不包括商戶、學校或組織。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Residents are one part of a community.

falseSynonyms.zh: 持份者不等於所有 community members stakeholders 因某決策或項目而受影響／有利益關係。
人口不等於 community population 是統計集合；community 強調關係、身份和互動。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Population is demographic, community is social.

falseSynonyms.zh: community groups 只是組織化的一部分 整個 local community 不一定全部屬於任何 group。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Groups are organised subsets.

falseSynonyms.zh: nearby 只強調距離接近 local communities 可以是行政／社會上本地但不一定緊鄰。
詞形陷阱 community 是名詞；communal 是形容詞，常表示共用／集體。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Community is a noun; communal is an adjective.
